cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor:/workspace/submission timeout 170 python3 -c "
import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from gen2 import gen_case, make_passing
from stress import build
import verify
from probability import window_thresholds
import numpy as np
rng = random.Random(24680)
cases=[]; tot=0
plans = [(3,4,2,1,1000000),(40,40,4,2,3000),(0,5,2,1,3000),(128,256,32,16,10**9),(200,64,8,4,3000),(1,2,1,0,3000),(150,80,6,3,20000),(500,256,20,10,10**9)]
for i,(J,S,F,G,span) in enumerate(plans):
    if tot>=1024: break
    J = min(J, 1024-tot)
    if i in (3,7):
        c = build(rng, J, S, F, G, 4, 5, True); make_passing(c, rng)
    else:
        c = gen_case(rng, J, S, F, G, span=span); make_passing(c, rng)
    c['model'] = 'rnn' if i%3 else 'cnn'
    if not c['windows'] and J>0:
        c['windows'] = [[0, 0, c['slots'][-1][0], 1, 1, 0, 1, [[1,1]]*9]]
    cases.append(c); tot += len(c['windows'])
req={'version':3,'cases':cases}
raw=json.dumps(req).encode()
print('cases',len(cases),'windows',tot,'in',len(raw))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True,env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LD_LIBRARY_PATH':'/workspace/native','PYTHONPATH':'/workspace/vendor'})
el=time.time()-t0
print('exit',p.returncode,'wall %.2f'%el,'out',len(p.stdout),'err',len(p.stderr))
r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
assert len(r['results'])==len(cases)
bad=0
for i,(c,res) in enumerate(zip(cases,r['results'])):
    n=len(c['windows'])
    if n:
        feats=np.array([w[7] for w in c['windows']],dtype=np.int64).reshape(n,9,2)
        preds=__import__('testcnnonnx' if c['model']=='cnn' else 'testrnnonnx').evaluate_model_single_pass(feats,np.zeros(n,dtype=np.int64))
    else: preds=[]
    th=window_thresholds(c['stats'],c['windows'])
    vals=[c['windows'][j][6]*c['class_values'][preds[j]] for j in range(n)]
    errs=verify.verify(c,res,th,vals)
    import metrics
    if json.dumps(metrics.selected_report(c['flows'],c['windows'],res['predictions'],res['assignment']),sort_keys=True)!=json.dumps(res['reports'],sort_keys=True):
        errs.append('reports')
    print(' case %d J=%d ratio=%s served=%d errs=%s'%(i,n,res['ratio'],sum(1 for a in res['assignment'] if a>=0),errs[:3]))
    if errs: bad+=1
print('BAD',bad)
"
